new_articles.title: Nasdaq sell-off batters Asian chip stocks as SK Hynix, Samsung, Softbank, TSMC tumble
new_articles.summary: SK hynix 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Nasdaq sell-off batters Asian chip stocks as SK Hynix, Samsung, Softbank, TSMC tumble'이다. Asian technology stocks tumbled Friday, tracking a sharp sell-off on Wall Street overnight that sent the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite into correction territory. Images of mobile devices at the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (TSMC) Museum of Innovation in Hsinchu, on Tuesday, Jan South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix plunged over 8%, while Samsung Electronics shed 7% LG Innotek and LG Display fell 10% and 7 7%, respectively, as selling pressure spread across the country's technology sector. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
